'''Living Witness''' is a April's Fools set for 2011 for the [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by the [[The Continuing Committee]] on 1 April 2011. The set consists of 2 cards.

The joke was that these were the first cards printable with moving images.
